y1ce5a44ab12.add: - **Baking soda on heating:** 2NaHCO3 → **Na2CO3 + H2O + CO2**; the CO2 makes cakes rise and powers the **soda-acid fire extinguisher**.

y107a760b047.add: - **Baking powder** = baking soda + a dry acid (**tartaric acid / cream of tartar**); with moisture and heat it releases **CO2**, which leavens cakes.

y98ccae4c7ee.add: - **ECG** records the **heart's** electrical activity (EEG – brain, EMG – muscles).

yf2cf86d5d0c.add: - **Tissue** = a group of **similar cells** doing a common function; **blood** is a fluid connective tissue (plasma + formed elements).

y2632d5098cb.add: - **Metal + dilute acid → hydrogen:** Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl2 + **H2**; hydrogen burns with a **pop** when a lighted match is brought near.

y404131381b6.add: - **How soap cleans:** soap lowers the **surface tension** of water; its molecules form **micelles** (hydrocarbon tail in the oily dirt, ionic head outside), an **emulsion** that is rinsed away; micelles are colloid-sized, so soap solution **scatters light** (looks cloudy).

y41ca3b1cc3d.add: - **Highest melting points:** **tantalum (hafnium) carbide** ~3,900 °C > **tungsten** ~3,420 °C (highest of the metals).

yf159dc6f6b9.add: - **Glacial acetic acid:** pure ethanoic acid melts at **290 K (16.6 °C)** – a fairly **high** melting point – so it **freezes in winter** in cold climates.

y5f38fb7ecc5.add: - **Force carriers:** **photon** – electromagnetic energy; gluon – strong force; W/Z – weak force; graviton (hypothetical) – gravity.

y7fa1c773830.add: - **Corymb inflorescence** (lower pedicels longer, flowers at one level): **Delonix regia (gulmohar)**, mustard-family plants; mango and teak – panicle.

yd3de14e380d.add: - **Antifreeze:** **ethylene glycol** in car radiators lowers (depresses) the **freezing point** of water.

y29a6a81563b.add: - **Water of crystallisation:** blue vitriol CuSO4·**5H2O**, washing soda Na2CO3·**10H2O**, gypsum CaSO4·**2H2O**; **baking soda NaHCO3 has none**; plaster of Paris CaSO4·½H2O.

y66f4449d826.add: - **Food allergy signs:** flushing/hives, swelling of lips and throat (**difficulty swallowing, speaking**), **fall in blood pressure** (anaphylaxis); not atherosclerosis.

yb79d6561465.add: - **Kohlberg's moral stages:** 1 punishment-avoidance → 2 self-interest → 3 good boy/girl → 4 **law and order** → 5 **social contract** → 6 **universal ethical principle** (highest).

y27ab2046835.add: - **Common salt (NaCl) is the raw material** for **NaOH, Cl2 (→ bleaching powder), baking soda and washing soda** (chlor-alkali and Solvay processes); slaked lime comes from **limestone**.

yee0aa2564fe.add: - **Type metal** (printing types) = **lead + antimony + tin**; **Rose metal** = bismuth + lead + tin (low-melting).

yff8006e9311.add: - **Amniocentesis** (amniotic fluid cells, chromosome test) confirms **Down's syndrome** (trisomy 21); ultrasound only screens.

y3cdbbb220a1.add: - **Kinds of glass:** **soft (soda-lime) glass** = sodium calcium silicate (windows, bottles); **hard glass** = potassium calcium silicate; **Pyrex/borosilicate** (contains **boron**) – harder and heat-resistant; **flint (lead) glass** – lenses, prisms, **electric bulbs**, optical instruments; glass has no sharp melting point (a supercooled liquid).

ye74a25dee16.add: - **Superheater (boiler) tubes:** **chromium-molybdenum (Cr-Mo) steel**; **stainless steel** = iron + **chromium** (+ nickel) – rust-free.

y60671a3f5d6.add: - **Washing machine** (spin drier) works on **centrifugation**; **cream separator** too.

y43066e9a38b.add: - **Ores:** **bauxite – aluminium**; haematite, **magnetite – iron**; cinnabar – mercury; galena – lead; **amalgam** = an alloy of **mercury**.

y35cf391b5e0.add: - **Thermoplastics** (soften on heating): polythene, PVC, polystyrene, Teflon; **thermosets**: Bakelite, melamine; **elastomers**: natural rubber (isoprene), **neoprene (chloroprene)**; Dacron (terylene) – a polyester.

y67337ce2f85.add: - **Boiling point falls with pressure:** at **high altitude** (low air pressure) water boils **below 100 °C**, so cooking is slower; a pressure cooker does the reverse.

yaa2a7ca733f.add: - **RADAR** = **radio waves** (aircraft, weather); **SONAR** = **ultrasonic** sound waves under water (**navigators**, submarines, ships, depth); **LIDAR** = laser light.

y3e8fc46c866.add: - **Polycarbonate** – tough and transparent: **bullet-proof windows**, CDs, helmets; **polyester blends**: polycot (polyester + cotton), terrycot (terylene + cotton), polywool.

yad84c579327.add: - **Gypsum** = CaSO4·2H2O (calcium) → plaster of Paris on heating; **china clay** = kaolin (Al silicate); **corundum** = Al2O3; **talc** = Mg silicate.

y4d426996106.add: - **Choke** of a tube light = an **inductor**: starting voltage surge, then limits current.

yfedf5f1cb3e.add: - **Hydrogen peroxide (H2O2):** mild antiseptic and **oxidising agent** – in two-bottle **hair dyes** it **oxidises the dye** to develop the colour; also a bleach.

yff6609fdec8.add: - **Soap vs detergent:** soap forms **scum (white curdy precipitate)** with hard water and does not work in acidic water; **detergents lather even in hard water** and clean more strongly. **Soft soap** = potassium (KOH) soap; hard soap = sodium soap.

yd007b9ddabe.add: - **Hair keratin** has **sulphur (disulphide) bonds**; hair setting/perming breaks and re-forms them; **henna** (lawsone) stains by binding to **proteins and amino acids** of skin and hair.

y0c4661ad466.add: - **Thermos flask:** **vacuum** between double glass walls stops conduction and convection; **silvered walls** reduce radiation; cork supports are poor conductors.

y7aa3f67c7c8.add: - **Cement** hardens by **hydration** (calcium silicates and aluminates + water); **gypsum** is added to slow setting.

yb945bed292d.add: - **UV water purifier** only **kills/inactivates microorganisms**; it does not remove odour, dissolved salts or turbidity.

y9ccd522ec76.add: - **Silica gel** = the common **desiccant** (absorbs moisture in packets).

y03f2776930b.add: - **Lime:** **quicklime CaO** + water → **slaked lime Ca(OH)2** (lime water); limestone = CaCO3.

y280f5f37e45.add: - **Toothpaste is basic** – neutralises mouth acids (tooth decay starts below pH 5.5); enamel = calcium phosphate.

y2991252f579.add: - **Slaked lime Ca(OH)2** (not CaO = quicklime, CaCO3 = limestone): whitewash, and **Cl2 + slaked lime → bleaching powder**.

y51f66123004.add: - **Electroplating:** passing **electric current** through a metal-salt solution deposits a thin film (gold on jewellery, chromium on taps, zinc/tin on iron).
